domain: Political Economy / Economic Ideology / Institutional Design
topic_summary: Analysis of the ideological naturalization of 'the free market' as a default institutional arrangement, examining whether this naturalization represents a lapsed-alternative closure (markets as spontaneous order requiring no maintenance) or a beneficiary-maintained engineered closure (incumbent actors defending post-hoc a system requiring continuous state intervention). The kernel contest tests whether different readings of 'market as natural default' emit structurally different constraints.

key_entities: Mont Pelerin Society / neoliberal architects (Hayek, Friedman - ideological framers)
Financial industry incumbents (beneficiaries of Glass-Steagall repeal)
Market fundamentalism ideology (the naturalization claim itself)
State regulatory apparatus (the hidden maintenance infrastructure)
Joseph Stiglitz, Paul Krugman, Edward Baptist (critics exposing engineered nature)
key_tensions: Spontaneous order narrative vs empirical requirement for state maintenance (lapsed vs engineered closure)
Market freedom rhetoric vs beneficiary power concentration (ideological framing vs structural outcome)
Deregulation as liberation vs deregulation as power transfer (freedom vs one-dollar-one-vote)
key_mechanisms: Ideological naturalization apparatus (think tanks, academic capture, public relations)
Regulatory capture and repeal (Glass-Steagall lobbying, Clinton administration pressure)
Crisis-response pattern (Great Depression regulation → golden age → deregulation → 2008 crisis)
Post-hoc defense maintenance (incumbent actors reframing failures as insufficient marketization)
key_absences: Explicit accounting of state enforcement costs for 'free' markets (property rights, contract law, bankruptcy courts)
Comparative analysis of which market rules are naturalized vs which remain visible as political choices

commitment_system_recognition.kernel_description: The claim that 'the market is the natural default institutional arrangement' - a shared substrate all parties argue about
commitment_system_recognition.authority_description: Economic expertise (academic economists, policy institutions) claims interpretive legitimacy over what counts as 'natural' vs 'artificial' market arrangements

readings.commitment: Markets emerge spontaneously from voluntary exchange; state intervention is artificial imposition
readings.authority_grounding: Austrian economics / Hayekian spontaneous order theory
readings.expected_structural_delta: State regulation enters victim set as constraint on natural freedom; deregulation is removal of artificial barriers; market failures are state-caused distortions

readings.commitment: Markets are state-engineered artifacts requiring continuous legal/regulatory maintenance
readings.expected_structural_delta: Market rules are political choices; 'deregulation' is re-regulation favoring different beneficiaries; state is constitutive not external

readings.commitment: Naturalization is post-hoc ideological defense by incumbent beneficiaries of existing market rules
readings.expected_structural_delta: Naturalization itself is the constraint mechanism; incumbent power enters beneficiary set; ideological apparatus is enforcement infrastructure

axiom_contradictions.basis: Spontaneous order axiom holds markets exist prior to and independent of state action; engineered infrastructure axiom holds markets are constituted by state legal frameworks. No coherent framework can hold both - either the state creates market possibility-space or it does not.

Spontaneous order axiom holds naturalization reflects discovered truth about market spontaneity; beneficiary maintenance axiom holds naturalization is strategic ideological construction. No coherent framework can hold both - either the claim is epistemically grounded or it is power-serving myth.

axes.human_readable: Spontaneous Order Reading (Markets as Pre-Political Natural Order)
axes.structural_delta: Markets emerge from voluntary exchange independent of state construction; regulation is artificial constraint on natural freedom
axes.primary_observable: Frequency of 'government interference' framing in policy discourse; deregulation presented as removal rather than re-regulation
axes.selection_reason: First reading of contested kernel; highest epsilon; establishes baseline naturalization claim

axes.human_readable: Engineered Infrastructure Reading (Markets as State-Constituted Artifacts)
axes.structural_delta: Markets require continuous state maintenance of property rights, contract enforcement, bankruptcy law; 'free market' is oxymoron
axes.primary_observable: State enforcement costs for market operation (courts, police, regulatory agencies); legal infrastructure density
axes.selection_reason: Second reading of contested kernel; mountain classification provides structural contrast to tangled_rope; axiom-contradictory to reading 1

axes.human_readable: Beneficiary Maintenance Reading (Naturalization as Incumbent Defense)
axes.structural_delta: Naturalization is post-hoc ideological construction by financial/corporate incumbents to defend favorable rule-sets
axes.primary_observable: Correlation between deregulation advocacy and incumbent profit concentration; think tank funding sources
axes.selection_reason: Third reading of contested kernel; highest centrality; snare classification captures ideological enforcement mechanism

axes.human_readable: Crisis-Response Regulatory Cycle (Depression → Regulation → Deregulation → Crisis)
axes.structural_delta: Recurring pattern of crisis-driven regulation followed by gradual erosion and re-crisis
axes.primary_observable: Timeline of Glass-Steagall (1933) → repeal (1999) → 2008 crisis; regulatory density over time
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: temporal pattern rather than structural reading; captured as mechanism within beneficiary_maintenance_reading

axes.human_readable: Ideological Naturalization Apparatus (Think Tanks, Academic Capture, PR)
axes.structural_delta: Infrastructure for producing and maintaining naturalization claim (Mont Pelerin Society, Chicago School, corporate-funded research)
axes.primary_observable: Think tank funding flows; academic department endowments; media placement frequency
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: enforcement mechanism for beneficiary_maintenance_reading rather than independent axis; omega material on apparatus effectiveness

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Recurring crisis → regulation → deregulation → re-crisis pattern
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Temporal mechanism rather than structural reading; captured within beneficiary_maintenance_reading's enforcement story

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Think tank and academic infrastructure producing naturalization
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Enforcement mechanism for beneficiary_maintenance_reading; omega material on apparatus effectiveness and funding opacity

omegas.description: Is the ideological apparatus (think tanks, academic capture) a Scaffold (temporary construction) or Piton (permanent infrastructure)? If permanent, does it survive empirical falsification (2008 crisis) or require continuous re-investment?
omegas.source: Deferred axis ideological_apparatus + Dark Matter Probe 3 (Beneficiary Scan)

omegas.description: Does Polanyi's 'double movement' (marketization → social protection → re-marketization) constitute a fourth reading, or is it a meta-pattern encompassing all three? If meta-pattern, what is the structural delta between cycles?
omegas.source: Extraction anchor (Polanyi's Great Transformation) + Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory)

omegas.description: What is the actual state expenditure on market-constituting infrastructure (property rights enforcement, contract law, bankruptcy courts)? If quantifiable, does it falsify spontaneous_order_reading or merely shift it to 'minimal state' defense?
omegas.source: Absence inventory (explicit accounting of enforcement costs) + engineered_infrastructure_reading observable

omegas.description: Can spontaneous_order_reading and beneficiary_maintenance_reading coexist as complementary (markets are natural AND incumbents defend favorable rules), or are they axiom-contradictory? If coexistent, what is the synthesis constraint?
omegas.source: Axiom contradiction testing + Dark Matter Probe 1 (Operational Medium)

fracture_scan.notes: No fractures detected. Kernel decomposition into three readings with axiom contradictions declared. All readings have distinct structural deltas, different beneficiary/victim structures, and would emit different constraint types. Crisis_response_cycle and ideological_apparatus deferred as mechanisms rather than independent readings.
